description:
Shareable reports at /r/<token>: anyone with the link reads them.
action:
- create(name?, sections?): A new report (sections left out take the app's defaults). Returns its link.
- edit(id, name?, sections?): Change its name or sections. The link stays.
- share(id): Its link.
- rotate_link(id): A new link: the old one stops working at once.
- remove(id): Delete a report and its link. Can't be undone.
name: update_reports
title: Change reports
